chapter: Chicago and New York with Louis Armstrong, 1925-30
title: The failed Ziegfeld audition
summary: The band auditioned for a Ziegfeld show, which Duke Ellington got, but Ziegfeld walked out on them.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Oh yes. Oh yes, during that time
they had a show. Duke Ellington got that too. That job, 'Show Girl' I think the name of it.
Yes the one with 'Liza' in it?
Yes. But anyway, it was a Ziegfeld show. And Ziegfeld, we made an audition you know, through Rockwell and that bunch. We made an audition and boy, Ziegfeld walked out on us.

He sure did. He couldn't see us at all. Because looked like Duke was sick to go in there, It was one of those things you know. But old Ziggle walked out on us and he had a gang of cats with him too. And oh, he was a handsome looking guy, yes.
